results.rationale: Consistency: The white background, upright silver forks and two-row arrangement persist, but the horizontal spacing and outer margins change visibly, and the forks acquire darker outlines and altered handle shading. Instruction: The source has eight forks and the edit still has eight, four per row; the expected six-fork image is not produced, so the count change is absent. Quality, edited image only: Shapes, four-tined heads, metal surfaces and white background are coherent; small dark protrusions at the right side of the fork necks are a minor repeated edge imperfection.

Consistency: The white background, metal blade details, green handles, diagonal orientations and shadows remain consistent; the small scissors sit slightly farther right relative to the large pair. Instruction: Both pairs retain their markedly different sizes. A compliant image would shrink the green-handled scissors to the small pair’s overall size, but they remain more than twice as long; the required resizing is absent. Quality, edited image only: Structural coherence, natural lighting, shadows and material textures are satisfactory. Both scissors have plausible blades and intact handle loops without noticeable generation artifacts.
